offering_description.value: Provides a clinical training, practice-support and supplement/pellet therapy platform for independent healthcare practitioners offering bioidentical hormone replacement therapy. Sells hormone pellets, nutraceuticals, training, diagnostics and marketing support to affiliated practices, which treat patients.

primary_products.value: hormone replacement pellets; dietary supplements; nutraceuticals

primary_services.value: practitioner clinical training; practice business and marketing support; patient lab and diagnostic programs; patient education and lead generation

customer_segment.value: B2B: Independent physician, nurse practitioner and clinic practices offering hormone therapy; B2C: Patients purchasing supplements through affiliated practices or online

end_markets.value: healthcare; hormone health and wellness; preventive and aging care

revenue_model.value: product sales: hormone pellets and supplements sold to affiliated practices; service fees: training, certification and practice support fees; subscription: recurring practice membership and program fees

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: markets branded pellets and supplements made by contract manufacturers, sold to practices; service provider: trains and supports practitioners with business and marketing services

geography_served.value: US national: Network of affiliated practices across the United States, with some international presence

specialization.value: related lines: hormone pellets, supplements, practitioner training and practice support

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sold directly to affiliated practices and clinicians; online: supplements ordered by patients through online store

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Compounded hormone pellets and supplements subject to FDA, state pharmacy and medical practice rules

notes: Details on pellet sourcing and international scope are from general knowledge and may be imprecise.
